components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action for creating, saving, or confirming a deliberate step.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:42px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#416de4,#3159d8);box-shadow:0 5px 12px -7px rgba(37,72,184,.7),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.23);color:#fff;font:550 13px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,transform 150ms ease}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover)}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #7290f0;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action such as clearing a filter or returning to a previous step.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled form field with helper, focus, and invalid states.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;min-width:0;color:var(--ink);font:550 14px/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-field input{width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(104,130,166,.32);border-radius:10px;background:var(--control-bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 15px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#6f737c;opacity:1}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #7290f0;outline-offset:3px}.ds-field input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--danger)}.ds-field small{color:var(--muted);font:400 12px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}

components.description: Marks the operator's current workspace route.

components.name: Campaign Document Surface
components.description: Frosted reading surface with crisp text and shared glass material.
components.html:
Forma Studio

Make space for better work

Campaign objective and plan status

Campaign strategy

Keep the message clear, useful, and grounded in the provided brief.
components.css: .ds-document{min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:16px;background:var(--glass-bg);box-shadow:var(--glass-shadow);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--glass-filter);backdrop-filter:var(--glass-filter);color:var(--ink);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-document header{padding:24px 34px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.ds-plan{padding:0 34px}.ds-document header p:first-child{margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:650}.ds-document h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:21px;font-weight:620;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-document header p:last-child{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.ds-document section{padding:35px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.ds-document h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.45}.ds-document section p{max-width:75ch;margin:0;color:#4e5360;font-size:13px;line-height:1.85;overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-document header{padding:18px 21px}.ds-plan{padding:0 21px}.ds-document section{padding:27px 0}}

narrative.overview: User-requested glassmorphism: floating frosted navigation and panels over a static ice-blue and pearl canvas. Navy text, more opaque fields, and cobalt controls keep marketing work legible. Unsupported blur and reduced-transparency preferences use solid surfaces. The Glass effects button follows system reduced transparency by default and stores explicit on/off choices locally when available.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp navy text and opaque controls

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Use the cobalt family for action and active wayfinding. Reserve separate semantic colors for statuses and validation, and pair those states with text or shape.

rules.name: The Glass Legibility Rule
rules.body: Use blur on outer surfaces, keep text crisp and controls readable, and provide solid fallbacks.

dos: Do keep the campaign text as the main visual material and make the next action easy to find.
Do use cobalt for primary actions, links, focus, and current wayfinding.
Do label simulated examples and distinguish fictional content from operator workspace state.
Do pair status color with a written label and a distinct form.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and responsive reflow.
Do keep review actions explicit and close to the plan they change.
donts: Don't add decorative imagery, dashboards, or motion that competes with campaign copy.
Don't use color as the only way to indicate status, confidence, or validation.
Don't add a fixed inspector that takes the campaign document's reading space.
Don't imply that generated audience insights are verified research or that simulated work is live.
Do not blur nested controls, animate backdrop filters, or lower text opacity to imitate glass.
